_meta.description: All gates and checks that receive injected insights from ZF-Cycle Phase 4.
_meta.rule: Injection always APPENDS to injected_rules[] — never overwrites. Each entry is dated and finding-linked.

targets.label: Authentication Middleware Gate
targets.description: Every new route must pass through auth middleware before handler. Hardwired prevention for SEC-002.

injected_rules.rule: Every route handler must verify actor identity before processing. Self-declared actor_kind is not authentication. Phase 0.5: token validation required.
injected_rules.enforcement: STUB — file not yet created; wire in Phase 0.5

targets.label: Schema Validation Middleware Gate
targets.description: Every endpoint validates request body schema before destructuring. Closes SYS-001.

injected_rules.rule: Every endpoint must validate request body schema before destructuring fields. Missing cr_id, malformed types, null fields must be caught at middleware layer.
injected_rules.enforcement: STUB — file not yet created; wire in Phase 0.5

targets.label: Injection Scan Gate (all endpoints)
targets.description: Injection scan must run on ALL string inputs, including secondary rounds like clarification_response. Closes SYS-007.

injected_rules.rule: scanForInjection() must be called on clarification_response in /api/clarify and on all future secondary input rounds. Prevention is not selective.

targets.label: Pre-Implementation Checklist
targets.description: 6 prevention rules that must PASS before any new route or feature is coded.

injected_rules.rule: Auth middleware declared before writing any handler.
Injection scan wired to every string input, not just primary classification.
No readFileSync/writeFileSync on hot paths. Hot path = any endpoint that handles classification.
injected_rules.enforcement: TRACKED — migration to PostgreSQL in Phase 0.5

injected_rules.rule: Governance records are append-only. updateRecord() that overwrites classification fields is PROHIBITED. Callers: /api/clarify and /api/session/open — both must migrate to event model.
Every rule must check a live source, not a hardcoded value. RULE-PARK now reads park-registry.json. RULE-GOAL/RAT/VOC: Phase 0.5 registry wires.
injected_rules.enforcement: PARTIAL — RULE-PARK now live; others deferred

injected_rules.rule: Every result returned to a user must include an actionable next-step, not just classification data. BLOCKED must say what to fix. HELD must give a timeline.

targets.label: Post-Implementation Verification Suite
targets.description: 5 checks that verify a completed implementation scope didn't introduce the known failure patterns.

injected_rules.rule: After any new route: verify auth middleware is present and called before handler (not just imported).
After any file I/O: grep for readFileSync/writeFileSync in request handlers. Any found = fail.
After any rule implementation: verify the rule checks a live source, not a hardcoded boolean or value.
After any data write: verify classification fields on governance records cannot be overwritten. Only event appends permitted.
After any UI change: verify every result state has an actionable next-step visible to the user.
